summary: Frontend-only regression for the P0 monolith→7-component extraction in /app/frontend/src/app/dashboard/shipments. All extracted dialogs (CreateShipmentDialog, ShipmentDetailDialog, AddJobsToShipmentDialog, BulkStatusDialog, JobDetailDialog, StoneEditDialog, FileViewerDialog) render and behave identically to iter-31. Zero console errors, zero pageerrors, all critical testids present, full flow verified end-to-end (list → detail → edit → cancel double-confirm → bulk status → add jobs → nested job detail → nested stone edit).
verified_flows: Shipments list page loads; create-shipment-button, shipments-status-filter, shipments-show-completed-toggle, shipments-completed-count, shipments-search-input all present. Show-completed toggle works (1 cancelled shipment becomes visible).

Create Shipment Dialog: ALL 7 form fields render (shipment-type-select, courier-select, source-address-select, destination-address-select, tracking-number-input, date-sent-input, notes-textarea). 78 JobPickerRow rows render with full details (Job# / service / client / type / stones·certs / weight / fee / value).

Shipment Detail Dialog opens on row click. Compact header meta strip renders Courier, From → To, Sent date (Tracking pill conditionally hidden when empty - intentional). Top-right buttons: Print PDF (testid=generate-pdf-button), Edit (edit-shipment-button), Add Jobs (add-jobs-button) all present. cancel-shipment-button is NOT in top-right outside edit mode (count=0). ✓
Edit mode reveals form (Type/Courier/From/To/Tracking/Date Sent/Notes inputs all visible in screenshot). save-shipment-edit-button + RED cancel-shipment-button appear inline. ✓
Cancel Shipment click opens DoubleConfirmDialog 'Cancel shipment ?' with Keep + 'Cancel Shipment' confirm button. Confirm flow wired (would call shipmentsApi.updateStatus(id,'cancelled',true)). ✓
Sticky footer shipment-totals-footer with all 6 totals: totals-jobs=3, totals-stones=6, totals-certificates=4, totals-weight='12.00 ct', totals-fees='$900', totals-value='$25,000'. ✓
Jobs table: 3 shipment-job-row-* clickable rows; bulk-status-button + confirm-bulk-status-button both present and bulk dialog opens on select+click.
Add Jobs to Shipment Dialog: 75 add-job-* rows render with full details, confirm-add-jobs-button present.

Nested Job Detail Dialog (via shipment-job-row click): print-job-shipment-button, edit-job-shipment-button, open-job-new-tab, upload-memo-shipment-button all present. Stones table renders grouped, 1 job-stone-row-* present per stone.

Nested Stone Edit Dialog (via job-stone-row click): ALL verbal inputs present (verbal-certificate-id input, verbal-weight input, verbal-identification select, verbal-color select, verbal-origin select, verbal-comment select) + save-stone-verbal-button + Upload Scan + Close. ✓
FileViewerDialog code review: correctly renders
Zero console errors and zero pageerrors observed across the full flow.
